title: BC Tech Days 2026
summary: The post reflects on BC Tech Days 2026, highlighting that AI agents dominated conference discussions and have become central to the Business Central community's focus. It emphasizes the shift from curiosity about AI capabilities to practical adoption questions.
key_points: AI agents were the dominant topic across all sessions and conversations at BC Tech Days 2026
The industry is shifting from theoretical interest in AI to practical adoption concerns and implementation strategies
Key questions emerging include how agents will affect development work, team preparation, and organizational adoption
Community sentiment is mixed, with some enthusiastic, some reluctant, and others being pushed toward agent adoption

quotes.text: Every session and conversation eventually came back to the same topic: Agent. Agent. Agent. And more agents.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that AI agents are now the dominant concern across the entire Business Central ecosystem, not a niche topic

quotes.text: Now people are asking practical questions. How will agents change development work? How do teams prepare for this shift?
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the industry has moved beyond theoretical interest to addressing concrete implementation challenges and business impact
